visual_goal: Show the deal service at the centre owning the agreement, with tax rules, document issuer and finance referral as separate components, and the lender, DMS, accounting and register as hand-offs outside a dashed platform boundary.
prompt: A left-to-right component illustration. A large dashed rounded boundary (no label) occupies the left two thirds. Inside it: at the far left a car-and-folder card labeled 'Stock item'; in the centre a large blue hub box with a handshake icon labeled 'Deal service'; above the hub a teal calculator box labeled 'Tax rules engine'; upper right of the hub a document-with-stamp box labeled 'Document issuer'; lower right of the hub, near the boundary, a green box labeled 'Finance referral'. Outside the boundary on the right, four plain grey boxes stacked top to bottom: 'Accounting package' level with 'Document issuer', then 'DMS adapter', then 'Register', then 'Lender' level with 'Finance referral'. Exactly eight arrows: 'Stock item' to 'Deal service' labeled 'reserve and sell'; 'Deal service' up to 'Tax rules engine' labeled 'compute lines'; 'Deal service' to 'Document issuer' labeled 'issue and number'; 'Deal service' to 'Finance referral' labeled 'refer application'; 'Finance referral' straight right to 'Lender'; 'Document issuer' straight right to 'Accounting package' labeled 'daily export'; 'Deal service' right to 'DMS adapter' labeled 'hand over deal'; 'Deal service' right to 'Register' labeled 'sale completed'. 'Lender' has exactly one incoming arrow, and it starts at 'Finance referral'. Each arrow that crosses the dashed boundary carries a small receipt-slip icon.
alt: The deal service sits between the stock item, a tax rules engine, a document issuer and a finance referral inside the platform; the lender, accounting package, DMS adapter and register are hand-offs outside it.

visual_goal: Show the deal's own state machine, with the financing loop and cancellation that after an invoice requires a credit note.
prompt: A simple state map of eight rounded tiles. Top row, left to right: blue 'Draft', blue 'Quoted', teal 'Signed', green 'Invoiced', green 'Delivered', dark green 'Closed'. Below 'Signed', an orange tile 'Finance pending'. Bottom centre, a red tile 'Canceled'. Exactly nine arrows: 'Draft' to 'Quoted' labeled 'quote issued'; 'Quoted' to 'Signed' labeled 'contract signed'; 'Signed' down to 'Finance pending' labeled 'financing condition'; 'Finance pending' back up to 'Signed' labeled 'approved'; 'Signed' to 'Invoiced' labeled 'invoice issued'; 'Invoiced' to 'Delivered' labeled 'handed over'; 'Delivered' to 'Closed' labeled 'paid and exported'; 'Signed' down to 'Canceled' labeled 'withdrawn'; 'Invoiced' down to 'Canceled' labeled 'credit note'. A small document icon inside 'Invoiced'.
alt: Deal states from Draft through Quoted, Signed, Invoiced and Delivered to Closed, with a Finance pending loop from Signed and cancellation either by withdrawal or, after an invoice, by credit note.

visual_goal: Show the financing referral: the platform requests quotes and carries the application, while the lender owns the decision, the credit agreement with the buyer and the payout.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with five vertical lanes, each headed by an icon and a label: a person with a tablet labeled 'Salesperson', a blue box labeled 'Deal service', a teal box labeled 'Finance referral', a bank building labeled 'Lender', a person labeled 'Buyer'. A light green band behind the 'Lender' and 'Buyer' lanes. Horizontal arrows top to bottom: 'Salesperson' to 'Deal service' labeled 'add financing'; 'Finance referral' to 'Lender' labeled 'quote request'; return arrow 'Lender' to 'Finance referral' labeled 'rate and example'; 'Salesperson' to 'Finance referral' labeled 'application'; 'Lender' to 'Buyer' labeled 'credit agreement'; return arrow 'Buyer' to 'Lender' labeled 'signed'; 'Finance referral' to 'Deal service' labeled 'condition met'; 'Lender' to 'Finance referral' labeled 'payout and commission'.
alt: Swimlanes for salesperson, deal service, finance referral, lender and buyer: the platform requests a quote and submits the application; the lender sends the credit agreement to the buyer, and reports the payout and commission back.
